description: PINFID crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group C 2/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C176 H196 O62 S12 Tb4 4-,4(C6 H16 N1 1+),3(C4 H10 O1),C1 H2 Cl2,4(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Tb1 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb2 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb3 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb4 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.376-4.376 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 126.05-126.05°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Tb4L4(H2O)6](Et3NH)4 · CH2Cl2 · 3(Et2O) · nH2O (L = fully deprotonated 7_4; crystallographic C213H300Cl2N4O69S12Tb4). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 6 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
